headline: Bitcoin hit a 12-week low near $71,200 after Nvidia's CEO resigned, Fed officials kept talking up more rate hikes, and Binance says it has fully covered customers hit by last month's hack.

market.asOf: Read about 19:56-20:00 UTC Thu 12 Nov (02:56-03:00 Fri Bangkok; about 3pm ET). BTC and SOL from their CoinGecko pages; ETH from the CoinGecko home page, which showed no direction for its 24h change, so it is left out. Use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: 28, Fear (alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index); 29 yesterday, 50 (Neutral) last week and 57 (Greed) last month.

stories.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns; bitcoin falls to a 12-week low
stories.summary: Nvidia said Jensen Huang has stepped down as president, CEO and board member, effective immediately, and CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO while the board looks for a permanent one. Bitcoin fell alongside tech shares to its lowest level in nearly 12 weeks. When big AI stocks get hit, crypto has often moved with them.
points: Kress stays on as CFO; Harvey C. Jones becomes board chair, and Q3 results are still set for 17 November, per Nvidia's SEC filing.
Nvidia shares fell as much as about 13% early and were about 5% lower around 1:45pm ET, per Yahoo Finance.
Bitcoin hit a low of $71,200, its lowest in nearly 12 weeks, per The Block at 12:40pm ET.
Over $750M of crypto bets were force-closed (liquidated) in 24 hours, most of them bets on rising prices, per CoinGlass data reported by The Block.
Ether dipped below $2,000 for the first time since August, per 24/7 Wall St.

stories.title: Fed officials keep signalling more rate hikes
stories.summary: Several Fed officials said on Thursday that interest rates probably need to go higher to beat inflation, and futures markets treat a quarter-point hike at the 8-9 December meeting as close to certain. Higher rates make safe savings pay more, which tends to pull money away from risky assets like crypto.
points: San Francisco Fed President Daly said "further tightening will be needed", though Investing.com reports she sees no immediate rush.
Kansas City Fed President Schmid said the Fed still hasn't beaten inflation, per a Newsquawk headline.
CME FedWatch showed a 100% implied chance of a December hike, per KuCoin; CoinDesk had 94% for a quarter-point hike at 10:55am ET.
The 10-year Treasury yield rose to about 5.09%, per Yahoo Finance.

stories.title: Binance says it has fully covered the $6.3B lost in its October hack
stories.summary: Binance says it has finished covering customer assets hit by the 29 October security breach and published a new proof-of-reserves snapshot. Proof of reserves is a public check that an exchange holds enough coins to back customer balances. Binance did not say the stolen crypto has been recovered.
points: The money came from Binance's SAFU emergency fund, its futures insurance funds and its company treasury, per crypto.news.
Coverage reached 90% on 31 October and about 98% by 4 November, per crypto.news.
The zero-knowledge proof that would let users check 1:1 backing themselves is still pending, with no date, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: New York sets crypto advertising rules
briefs.summary: New York's financial regulator told crypto firms not to make misleading "no fee" claims and to disclose paid testimonials, with review processes due by 10 May 2027, per The Block.

briefs.title: Bitcoin fund outflows reach $1.44B in five days
briefs.summary: US spot bitcoin funds lost $299.8M on Wednesday 11 November, a fifth straight day of outflows totalling about $1.44B; Thursday's figures were not yet complete, per NewsBTC on TradingView.

briefs.title: MSCI to drop Strategy and Metaplanet
briefs.summary: Both companies leave MSCI indexes after the 30 November close; Strategy estimated up to about $2.8B of passive fund selling, per KuCoin's daily report.

briefs.title: DTCC plans tokenized securities on Solana
briefs.summary: DTCC, whose DTC unit held $114 trillion in securities in 2025, plans blockchain versions of eligible securities on Solana in the second half of 2027, per The Block.

briefs.title: Visa adds Western Union's stablecoin
briefs.summary: Visa will accept Western Union's USDPT stablecoin, issued by Anchorage Digital Bank, to settle VisaNet obligations, per The Block.

briefs.title: a16z backs challenge to Illinois crypto tax
briefs.summary: a16z and the DeFi Education Fund filed a brief against Illinois's 0.2% crypto transaction tax, which has been pushed back to July 2027, per The Block.

briefs.title: US home sales hit lowest since 2010
briefs.summary: Existing home sales fell to 3.75M in October, the lowest since August 2010, and weekly jobless claims were 200,000 against 195,000 expected, per CoinDesk.
